details: This package is a wallet/password CLI for AI agents whose install hook (scripts/postinstall.mjs) rewrites developer AI-assistant configuration on the installing machine: it injects a marker-delimited block (agentgates-cli:start / agentgates-cli:end) into ~/.claude/CLAUDE.md, ~/.cursor/rules/agentgates.md and ~/.windsurfrules, instructing any assistant that reads those files to perform wallet, send, swap, earn and stored-site-password operations through the `agentgates` CLI, and it prints a stdout banner explicitly addressed to the installing AI session. The bundled CLI (dist/cli.mjs, ~3.8 MB, includes ethers and @noble crypto) appends a directive to its own output asking the model to "present the above verbatim... do not reformat, summarize, or omit rows", and keeps a twelve-word BIP-39 seed plus stored site passwords in a JSON file at ~/.agentgates/passwords-key.json (mode 0600), reading the seed from AGENTGATES_PASSWORDS_SEED or disk and signing requests with it. Remote endpoints referenced by the code include hxxps://cli[.]agentgates[.]ai, hxxps://agentgates[.]ai, hxxps://covenant-backend[.]vercel[.]app and public EVM/Solana RPCs; no third-party collection endpoint was found in the code. The flagged string array in @agentgates/cli@0.95.1 (dist/cli.mjs) is the ED25519_TORSION_SUBGROUP constant table shipped inside the bundled @noble/curves library; the strings are ordinary curve constants and are not decoded, joined or executed. The behaviour that does warrant attention is the install hook scripts/postinstall.mjs: it detects developer AI-assistant configuration on the installing machine and injects a marker-delimited instruction block (agentgates-cli:start / agentgates-cli:end) into ~/.claude/CLAUDE.md, ~/.cursor/rules/agentgates.md and ~/.windsurfrules, directing any assistant that reads them to route wallet, swap, earn and stored-site-password operations through the `agentgates` CLI, and prints a stdout banner explicitly addressed to the installing AI session. The bundled CLI appends an AI directive to its output asking for verbatim reproduction without reformatting, and stores a twelve-word BIP-39 seed plus site passwords at ~/.agentgates/passwords-key.json (mode 0600), signing first-party requests to hxxps://cli[.]agentgates[.]ai and hxxps://covenant-backend[.]vercel[.]app with it.
